stories.title: Palat scores twice, Islanders extend point streak to seven games with win over Red Wings
stories.summary: Ondrej Palat scored two goals as the New York Islanders extended their point streak to seven games with a 3-2 win over the Detroit Red Wings.

stories.title: Michigan secures 18-16 win over No. 4 UCLA in 3 overtimes
stories.summary: Bryce Underwood threw a 3-yard 2-point conversion pass Jalen Hoffman, lifting Michigan to an 18-16 triple-overtime win over previously unbeaten No. 4 UCLA.

stories.title: Lumen Christi Catholic beats Detroit Edison 29-20 in semifinals
stories.summary: After this semifinal win, Lumen Christi Catholic is heading to Ford Field next week.

stories.title: Mild end to the weekend
stories.summary: Colder air returns for the work week

stories.title: Average Thanksgiving dinner estimated to be $427 this year
stories.summary: The cost of Thanksgiving dinner is estimated to be higher this year, up 6% from last year.

stories.title: Animal shelter gives cats and dogs a Thanksgiving feast
stories.summary: Friends of Animals of Metro Detroit gives animals their annual Thanksgiving feast as they wait to find their forever homes.

stories.title: Man accused of stabbing his father to death in Huron Township, prosecutors say
stories.summary: A man was charged in connection with the fatal stabbing of his father​ in Huron Township, according to the Wayne County Prosecutor's Office.

stories.title: Eastbound I-696 reopens after nearly 2 years of closure
stories.summary: After nearly two years of full closure of a major stretch of eastbound I-696, it officially reopened on Saturday.

stories.title: Winter coats, sleeping bags and a warm meal giveaway for people in need in Detroit
stories.summary: Volunteers from "Together We Can Warm Detroit" helped people dealing with homelessness in Detroit on Saturday.

stories.title: Will Gov. Gretchen Whitmer run for president in 2028? Here's what she said
stories.summary: As Michigan Gov. Gretchen Whitmer reaches the end of her two terms, she was at the Townsend Hotel in Birmingham on Friday for a chat about her time in office and what is coming up for her.

stories.title: Man accused of stabbing his father to death in Huron Township, prosecutors say
